<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Volunteer a Shot</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Volunteer a Shot means to leave a blot now deliberately because being forced to leave one later may be worse. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
